CheckTitle: Active Okta users have MFA enabled
Description: Ensure every active Okta user has at least one active MFA factor enrolled.
Risk: Okta users without MFA are more exposed to credential theft, phishing, and password reuse attacks.

Code.Other: Require MFA in Okta authenticator enrollment policies and ensure active users enroll an active MFA factor.

Recommendation.Text: Require MFA for active Okta users and follow up with users that have no active MFA factor enrolled.
